Rationale: the two published faces of one key disagree, and the wide face validates values the renderer measurably breaks on (`buttonVariant: 'primary'` → colourless button; `''` → silent default) — a declared≠enforced defect, not a feature. The narrowing direction is settled by the sibling ruling this card cites: #6496 landed exactly this spelling (`z.enum` of the six Button variants) on `ToastSchema` for the same trigger mechanism, with a two-direction parity pin already in place — inherited ruling plus its reasoning, so this enters the queue directly rather than the decision inbox. Dispatch note: it *is* an accept-set narrowing on a published surface — the PR should state that plainly, extend `toast-button-variant-parity.test.ts` to cover `SonnerSchema` (the card's one-line addition), and if the dev finds any consumer legitimately relying on a seventh spelling, stop and report a fork rather than forcing the enum.

Bug tier.

### Triage's ruling, verbatim

> the two published faces of one key disagree, and the wide face validates values the renderer measurably breaks on (`buttonVariant: 'primary'` → colourless button; `''` → silent default) — a declared≠enforced defect, not a feature. The narrowing direction is settled by the sibling ruling this card cites: #6496 landed exactly this spelling (`z.enum` of the six Button variants) on `ToastSchema` for the same trigger mechanism, with a two-direction parity pin already in place — inherited ruling plus its reasoning, so this enters the queue directly rather than the decision inbox. Dispatch note: it *is* an accept-set narrowing on a published surface — the PR should state that plainly, extend `toast-button-variant-parity.test.ts` to cover `SonnerSchema` (the card's one-line addition), and if the dev finds any consumer legitimately relying on a seventh spelling, stop and report a fork rather than forcing the enum.

### ⚠️ Say the narrowing out loud

This **removes** values the published mirror currently accepts. That is the right direction — it is restoring declared = enforced, and the wide face was validating values the renderer visibly breaks on — but it is still an accept-set narrowing on a published surface, and the PR body must say so in those words. A narrowing described as "a fix" reads as risk-free to the next reviewer; described as a narrowing, it gets the attention it deserves.

The measurement that justifies it is already on `main`, landed by #6496 an hour ago: on cva 0.7.1, an unrecognised variant contributes no variant class and `defaultVariants` applies only when the value is absent or falsy — so `'primary'` renders a button with no background and no text colour, and `''` silently renders the default look.

### The model is on `main` — inherit it, don't reinvent it

#6496 (merged as part of `main`) landed exactly this spelling on `ToastSchema`: a `z.enum` of the six `buttonVariants` keys (`default`, `secondary`, `destructive`, `outline`, `ghost`, `link`), on **both** faces, matched to `ButtonProps['variant']` as ground truth rather than to a sibling's shape.

⭐ Note the irony this card is built on: `SonnerSchema`'s TS face **already** carries the six-member union (`packages/types/src/feedback.ts:255`); it is the **zod mirror** that is the open `z.string()`. So you are not choosing a shape — you are making the mirror agree with a declaration that has been sitting beside it all along.

Extend `packages/components/src/__tests__/toast-button-variant-parity.test.ts` to cover `SonnerSchema` — the card's own one-line addition.

### ⭐ The blind instrument this card is a member of

The card itself records why nothing caught this:

> `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` cannot catch this class, because it compares in one direction only (mirror accepts everything declared), so a mirror **wider** than its declaration passes and carries no ledger entry.

Do not add your pin to that file expecting it to help — it is one-directional by construction. The parity pin in `packages/components` is where the two-direction check lives, because that is where `Button` is visible. ⛔ And do not "fix" `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts` as a rider; if you think its one-directionality should change, that is its own card.

### File face

`packages/types/src/zod/feedback.zod.ts`, `packages/components/src/__tests__/toast-button-variant-parity.test.ts`, and a changeset.

`packages/types/src/feedback.ts` should need **no change** — its TS face already declares the union. If you find yourself editing it, stop and re-read the premise.

### Clause-② note

The published shape changes (narrows). Establish it on the **built** `dist/index.d.ts` with the re-export chain shown to terminate — ⛔ not from a source `export` keyword, an empty entry-file diff, a grep of the entry, or the export list alone.

### In-flight, do not touch

#6465 (`app-shell`/`core` test headers) · #6332 (`plugin-grid`) · #6534 (`app-shell` providers) · #6538 (`views/metadata-admin/`), plus open PRs #6543, #6544, #6546.

### Stop and report

Any consumer legitimately relying on a seventh spelling ⇒ that is a fork, not a value to force into the enum.
